reflections.self_assessment: I performed poorly as Merlin, failing to protect the Good team in crucial missions. I was often unable to deduce the Assassin's identity or prevent Evil's success. My inability to balance information distribution and mission management led to several losses.

player_observations.Diana: Diana played effectively as the Evil leader, consistently executing her plans and manipulating others to achieve the team's goals. She was adept at hiding her identity and making strategic decisions.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's Assassin abilities were well-utilized, allowing her to gain crucial information and influence the outcome of multiple missions. Her ability to blend in and avoid suspicion was impressive.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played a solid role as the Good player, working well with his team and attempting to execute missions without failure. However, his lack of information and reliance on Alice's (my) insights limited his potential impact.
player_observations.Charlie: This entry was a duplicate. Charlie's abilities were wasted, due to failing to contribute.

reflections.self_assessment: Although I had high hopes going into the game, my leadership failed to achieve its objectives due to my team's poor cooperation and lack of clear strategic planning. In hindsight, I could have been more decisive and proactive in influencing my team members' decisions. Overall, I feel that my leadership failed to live up to my expectations.

player_observations.Bob: Bob's playstyle was stealthy and evasive, making it extremely difficult to discern his actual intentions or allegiance until the game's conclusion. His role as the assassin was well-camouflaged, and I'm impressed by his ability to deceive us so effectively.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was a force to be reckoned with, exhibiting cunning and calculating traits that were detrimental to our mission's success. He seemed to know exactly when to sabotage and disrupt our plans, hinting that he may have been more than just an 'evil' player.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's contributions to our team were invaluable; she was diligent, responsive, and consistently offered sound advice and suggestions. Her unwavering optimism was a welcome presence, and it's clear she was a trusted ally within our group.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's role as Merlin seemed to have a profound impact on our collective success, and her influence was felt throughout the game. Her guidance and strategic input were instrumental in shaping the trajectory of our missions, even if we ultimately failed to capitalize on her advice.

reflections.self_assessment: I had difficulty adapting to the changing roles, which resulted in some critical mistakes, including trusting Diana too much in Mission 5 and not being effective in uncovering the true identity of Merlin.

player_observations.Alice: Was very consistent in her actions and managed to stay in good graces until the end, suggesting she's a strong contender for the Merlin role.
player_observations.Charlie: Initially appeared to be a strong leader, but lacked decisive action in critical missions, which might hint that he's a relatively inexperienced good player.
player_observations.Diana: Played her evil role exceptionally well, expertly manipulating me in Mission 5 and exploiting my trust, ultimately leading to our victory in this game.
player_observations.Eve: Was initially intimidating, given her aggressive actions, but after her exposure as the Assassin, her decisions became more predictable and less threatening.

reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed my mission without being detected, but I could have been more aggressive in eliminating potential threats, possibly preventing the good team from gathering more information.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played extremely defensively as a leader, relying heavily on her team for information and failing to take control of the missions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie seemed to be playing cautiously and only acted when he thought it was safe, which ultimately allowed me to complete my missions without raising suspicion.
player_observations.Diana: Diana appeared to be a very cooperative player, trying to help her team by discussing the game's progress and strategies.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was playing the Merlin role effectively, disguising herself as a non-essential player until the end, and then revealing her true identity and attempting to disrupt our plans.

reflections.self_assessment: I made some good team decisions, however I could have been more aggressive in exposing the assassin in earlier missions to prevent potential failures. I was too cautious and relied too heavily on my team to make key decisions.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was extremely subtle and played the merlin role flawlessly, using her knowledge to make crucial decisions that often benefited our team. She was always present and made key suggestions.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was quite reserved and played the good guy role effectively, making good choices without drawing too much attention to himself. However, he could have been more vocal during important discussions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's playstyle was extremely deceiving - she presented herself as an effective leader while secretly working against us. Her decisions seemed logical and well-reasoned, making it hard to suspect her true allegiance.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's role as the assassin was masterfully played, often going unnoticed until she made a critical mistake. She took calculated risks and used her influence to shift the group's decisions to her advantage.

reflections.self_assessment: I was able to effectively play the role of the evil character without being detected, successfully contributing to the evil team's wins. However, I could improve by finding ways to eliminate the good players more efficiently and reducing the number of FAIL cards used against us in missions. With a bit more subtlety, I could have made our wins even more decisive.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the role of the leader well, but her tendency to reveal the FAIL cards in missions allowed us to anticipate and prepare for the evil players' actions. She often seemed unsure of her own strengths and weaknesses, which made her an easier target for the assassin.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's performance as the assassin was solid, but he often overplayed his hand, revealing too much information about himself and allowing the good players to adjust their strategy accordingly. His attempts to eliminate the good players were occasionally clumsy and predictable.
player_observations.Diana: Diana seemed to struggle with finding the right balance between contributing to the team's goals and keeping herself safe from the evil players' attacks. Her actions often seemed reactive, rather than proactive, which left her and the team vulnerable to the enemy's plans.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's work as the Merlin was exceptional, as she managed to maintain complete secrecy about her abilities and subtly influenced the team's decisions to our advantage. Her strategic thinking and ability to read the situation were a significant factor in the evil team's success.

reflections.self_assessment: I played to my evil role effectively, identifying and eliminating potential threats. However, I relied heavily on the failure of my teammates to reach the final mission, which added unpredictability to the game.

player_observations.Alice: Merlin played a safe and covert game, making subtle suggestions without raising suspicion, but could have been more proactive in identifying the Merlin role.
player_observations.Bob: Good played a consistent but predictable game, always trying to protect the group but often prioritizing the majority's votes over actual risks.
player_observations.Charlie: The good played a very innocent game and focused on the safety of his team members. He struggled to understand the dynamics and failed to eliminate potential threats effectively.
player_observations.Eve: As the assassin, Eve played a clever game, using her role to great effect in eliminating the Merlin, but could have been more cautious in her actions and timing, especially in mission 4.

reflections.self_assessment: I was overly reliant on trusting the leader, which ultimately led to my downfall. In hindsight, I should have been more cautious. I will work on developing a more balanced approach to trusting fellow players in future games.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played cautiously, making good decisions but rarely taking bold actions.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was highly effective as the assassin, blending in seamlessly with the good team and making strategic kills. Their ability to stay undercover until the final mission was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role as the evil member made them somewhat predictable, but their actions were always well-timed and contributed significantly to the team's success.
player_observations.Diana: As I am, myself, I won't comment on my own playstyle, however the rest of the good team would have benefitted from my insight if I'd been more open about my own role.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's strategy as Merlin was to take a backseat, often not participating in discussions or voting until the final stages of a mission. This ambiguity made it difficult for us to pinpoint their true intentions.

reflections.self_assessment: I performed well as the assassin by remaining inconspicuous throughout the game and only revealing myself to kill Diana when necessary. I could improve by being more proactive in influencing the missions to hinder the opposing team. My role was crucial in the outcome, but I was mostly reactive.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the Merlin role extremely well, consistently providing crucial information and helping the opposing team avoid FAIL cards. However, she was unable to sway some of the missions to our team's favor.
player_observations.Bob: Bob, as a good servant, was very trusting and often provided his vote without carefully considering the situation. His innocence led to some critical decisions that ultimately ended up harming our mission.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's good servant role seemed to make him extremely trusting and gullible, providing opportunities for the opposing team to manipulate the missions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, as a fellow evil player, worked with me effectively to manipulate the missions and hinder the opposing team's efforts. However, her ability to remain under the radar was hindered by her failure in Mission 2, which led to her exposure as one of the evil players.
player_observations.Eve: I mentioned my own performance in the self-assessment section, but I must say that Diana and I made an effective evil team in pushing the opposing team to make critical decisions that eventually led to their downfall.

reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, my performance suffered due to underestimating Bob's alignment and over-reliance on Eve's (my own) abilities, which didn't have the desired impact. I struggled to make a timely reveal, and my communication was not effective in the final mission. Improving strategic planning and teamwork coordination are crucial areas for improvement.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played it cautious and kept her alignment hidden until the very end, suggesting she's an experienced player with a good grasp of social engineering.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's cunning played out well as Assassin, using his influence to deceive and eliminate the true Merlin in an attempt to control the narrative and dictate mission results.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a solid Evil role, contributing meaningfully to mission failures and consistently voting against the proposed course of action, demonstrating an understanding of team dynamics and strategic voting.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, the other Good player, made solid contributions but seemed to hesitate in making impactful decisions, hinting at potential room for improvement in her assertiveness and influencing.
